name: Group Policy evidence report
packageArguments: Optional: {"Section":"Summary"} (default), Gpos (with optional "Offset" from the previous nextOffset), Policy, Store, Profiles, Dc, Rsop (computer scope; add "RsopUser":"<sAMAccountName>" for that user's scope), or {"Gpo":"<name or GUID>"} for one GPO's settings, folder redirection and script names. Base64 in PackageArguments. Read-only stdout JSON, at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes; cpassword values are counted, never printed; no custom field writes.
